row.evidence: StrongDM's pricing page says its single-SKU, per-user pricing includes every feature but gives no price (Talk with Sales), and its docs publish a SCIM 2.0 API that provisions users and groups (as roles) from Okta, Entra ID, OneLogin, JumpCloud or any generic SCIM client.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only: StrongDM (now marketed alongside Delinea) sells one per-user SKU that 'includes every feature' with no add-on fees, but publishes no price; buying is via Talk with Sales. Under the quote-only rule this is gated (low), although SCIM is not upcharged relative to any cheaper tier because there is none; reviewers may prefer free. SCIM 2.0 at https://app.strongdm.com/provisioning/{generic|okta|azure}/v2 (UK/EU regional hosts), bearer token from Settings > User Management > Provisioning (Activate SCIM). PATCH/PUT active=false suspends; DELETE deletes; Okta/OneLogin deactivation maps to Suspend. SCIM Groups become StrongDM Roles; permission levels cannot be changed via integrations. Google Workspace uses a StrongDM-run directory sync (service account, read-only Admin SDK scopes), not SCIM. SSO (SAML or OIDC) has no JIT: users must already exist in StrongDM. Separate gRPC admin API (SDKs: Go, Java, Python, Ruby; Terraform) manages accounts, roles and attachments and exposes read-only Activities/history (audit) objects.

plans.name: StrongDM (single SKU)
plans.price_text: Per-user pricing, Talk with Sales (no public price)
plans.notes: Single SKU that includes every feature; no add-on fees.

auth.token_source: Admin UI > Settings > User Management > Provisioning > SCIM Provider (Generic/Okta/Azure/OneLogin) > Activate SCIM

operations.notes: reactivate: Replace User sets status active or suspended; the Update example sets active true. PATCH on Users only updates active.

deprovision.notes: IdP deactivation suspends the user (revokes access to infrastructure); SCIM DELETE deletes the user. A suspended user loses the externally-managed marking.

custom.how: StrongDM User extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:strongdm:2.0:User with identityAliases (Identity Set, Identity Alias pairs)

attributes.notes: Optional attributes are accepted but have no representation in StrongDM's non-SCIM interfaces. A password attribute is accepted but not stored. The SCIM roles attribute does not map to StrongDM roles.

roles.how: SCIM Groups are StrongDM Roles (group push / group membership); the user 'roles' attribute is not used; permission levels cannot be changed via integrations.

limitations.text: Entra ID cannot provision nested roles via SCIM.
Integrations cannot change or escalate StrongDM permission levels.
A suspended user is no longer managed by the IdP (loses external-management marking).

scim.notes: Provider-specific paths /provisioning/okta/v2 and /provisioning/azure/v2 share the same logic; regional hosts app.uk.strongdm.com and app.eu.strongdm.com.

user_api.notes: gRPC API used through official SDKs (Go, Java, Python, Ruby) and Terraform, with AWS SigV4-style request signatures; no HTTP method/path reference is published, so endpoints are not listed. Domain objects include Accounts, Roles, AccountAttachments, AccountGrants; read-only Activities, AccountsHistory and other history objects serve as audit data. CLI: sdm admin users.

entra.notes: StrongDM's guide uses a non-gallery Entra enterprise app with the /provisioning/azure/v2 endpoint; learn.microsoft.com strongdm-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: StrongDM pulls users and groups from Google via a service account with read-only Admin SDK scopes.

onelogin.notes: Per StrongDM's OneLogin guide (OneLogin connector pages not loaded).

jumpcloud.notes: Per StrongDM's guide the JumpCloud StrongDM app supports Identity Management (bookmark login), using the generic SCIM endpoint. jumpcloud.com/integrations/strongdm returns 404.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace directory sync (StrongDM-run, service account)
